_comment: Files held to 100% line AND branch coverage.
This list is a ratchet: entries may be added, never removed. It starts as
the code this PR introduces rather than all of src/, so the PR is not
blocked on pre-existing untested legacy, while still converging there.
Path coverage is deliberately NOT gated: it is combinatorial, and a fully
covered class routinely sits at 25% paths.
src/Services.php is excluded: it is pure wiring whose branches are which WordPress environment is present, exercised by the integration suite.
